annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1559/2024 - Altera a Lei de Diretrizes e Bases da Educação Nacional para vedar o uso de inteligência artificial como parâmetro de referência e métrica para material pedagógico e avaliação de desempenho escolar
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1559/2024 - Amends the National Education Guidelines and Framework Law to prohibit the use of artificial intelligence as a reference parameter and metric for pedagogical material and school performance assessment
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Professora Luciene Cavalcante, PSOL/SP)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill amending the national education law (LDB) to ban AI-generated content as a reference or metric for pedagogical material and as a school performance assessment tool in public schools. It makes MEC AI tools optional support only, requires teacher supervision against algorithmic discrimination, and requires privacy-by-design.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bans use of AI/media-platform content as reference or metric for public-school pedagogical material
Bans AI as a tool for assessing school performance
MEC-provided AI tools only as optional research support, never mandatory
Teachers must supervise AI outputs to prevent algorithmic discrimination
MEC must ensure safe, trustworthy AI with privacy by design and protection of personal data
